### Integration Trapezoidal Rule

\[\int_{x_{0}}^{x_{1}}f(x)dx = \frac{h}{2}\left(f_{0}+f_{1}\right)-\frac{1}{2}\int_{x_{0}}^{x_{1}}(t-z_{0})(x_{1}-t)f^{\prime\prime}(t)dt\] \[= \frac{h}{2}\left(f_{0}+f_{1}\right)-\frac{h^{3}}{12}f^{\prime\prime}(\xi)\]

#### Error Term in Trapezoidal Formula for Periodic Functions

If \(f(x)\) is periodic and has a continuous \(k^{\text{th}}\) derivative, and if the integral is taken over a period, then

\[\left|\text{Error}\right| \leq \frac{\text{constant}}{m^{k}}\] Modified Trapezoidal Rule \[25.4.4\] \[\int_{x_{0}}^{x_{m}}f(x)dx = h\left[\frac{f_{0}}{2}+f_{1}+\ldots+f_{m-1}\frac{f_{m}}{2}\right]\] \[+\frac{h}{24}\left[-f_{-1}+f_{1}+f_{n-1}-f_{n+1}\right] +\frac{11m}{720}\,h^{sf(q)}(\xi)\]

NUMERICAL ANALYSIS (p.885)
Laplacian
25.3.30  [FIGURE: 5-point cross stencil -- one point above, below, left, right of center]
\nabla^2u_{0,0}=\left(\frac{\partial^2u}{\partial x^2}+\frac{\partial^2u}{\partial y^2}\right)_{0,0}=\frac{1}{h^2}(u_{1,0}+u_{0,1}+u_{-1,0}+u_{0,-1}-4u_{0,0})+O(h^2)
25.3.31  [FIGURE: 9-point cross stencil -- extended arms of 2 points each direction]
\nabla^2u_{0,0}=\frac{1}{12h^2}[-60u_{0,0}+16(u_{1,0}+u_{0,1}+u_{-1,0}+u_{0,-1})-(u_{2,0}+u_{0,2}+u_{-2,0}+u_{0,-2})]+O(h^4)
Biharmonic Operator
25.3.32  [FIGURE: 13-point stencil -- cross of 2 points each arm plus 4 diagonal corner points]
\nabla^4u_{0,0}=\left(\frac{\partial^4u}{\partial x^4}+2\frac{\partial^4u}{\partial x^2\partial y^2}+\frac{\partial^4u}{\partial y^4}\right)_{0,0}=\frac{1}{h^4}[20u_{0,0}-8(u_{1,0}+u_{0,1}+u_{-1,0}+u_{0,-1})+2(u_{1,1}+u_{1,-1}+u_{-1,1}+u_{-1,-1})+(u_{0,2}+u_{2,0}+u_{-2,0}+u_{0,-2})]+O(h^2)
25.3.33  [FIGURE: 21-point stencil -- cross of 3 points each arm plus 8 diagonal points in two rings]
\nabla^4u_{0,0}=\frac{1}{6h^4}[-(u_{0,3}+u_{0,-3}+u_{3,0}+u_{-3,0})+14(u_{0,2}+u_{0,-2}+u_{2,0}+u_{-2,0})-77(u_{0,1}+u_{0,-1}+u_{1,0}+u_{-1,0})+184u_{0,0}+20(u_{1,1}+u_{1,-1}+u_{-1,1}+u_{-1,-1})-(u_{1,2}+u_{2,1}+u_{1,-2}+u_{2,-1}+u_{-1,2}+u_{-2,1}+u_{-1,-2}+u_{-2,-1})]+O(h^4)
25.4. Integration
Trapezoidal Rule
25.4.1  \int_{x_0}^{x_1} f(x)dx=\frac{h}{2}(f_0+f_1)-\frac12\int_{x_0}^{x_1}(t-x_0)(x_1-t)f''(t)\,dt=\frac{h}{2}(f_0+f_1)-\frac{h^3}{12}f''(\xi) \quad (x_0<\xi<x_1)
Extended Trapezoidal Rule
25.4.2  \int_{x_0}^{x_m} f(x)dx=h\left[\frac{f_0}{2}+f_1+\dots+f_{m-1}+\frac{f_m}{2}\right]-\frac{mh^3}{12}f''(\xi)
Error Term in Trapezoidal Formula for Periodic Functions
If f(x) is periodic and has a continuous k^{th} derivative, and if the integral is taken over a period, then
25.4.3  |\mathrm{Error}|\leq\frac{\mathrm{constant}}{m^k}
Modified Trapezoidal Rule
25.4.4  \int_{x_0}^{x_m} f(x)dx=h\left[\frac{f_0}{2}+f_1+\dots+f_{m-1}+\frac{f_m}{2}\right]+\frac{h}{24}[-f_{-1}+f_1+f_{m-1}-f_{m+1}]+\frac{11m}{720}h^5f^{(4)}(\xi)
